featureUpdate: Audited full/partial manual refund records with original receipt/bill links, cashier manager approval, immutable credit documents and net financial reporting.
hostedVerificationScope: Five manual refund, approval, immutable history, concurrency, authorization and recognition cases in one isolated PostgreSQL database.
checkpoint: Q91 released: owner/manager may record an already-returned manual full or partial refund; a cashier can request a scoped manager approval with no financial effect until approval. Amounts are capped by remaining actual verified receipts and the chosen issued bill; concurrent/duplicate/stale requests cannot create excess refunds. Reason, mode, original invoice/receipt links and explicit confirmation are required. Immutable refund documents retain allocation and credit-component snapshots; original invoices, receipts, round amounts, stock costs and reward history stay unchanged. Reports show original gross collections and separate refunds with net receipts/sales; a provisional-bill refund is recognized once when the final sale is issued. No gateway reversal is triggered. Eight affected cases, all 254 backend cases, five isolated hosted PostgreSQL cases and desktop/phone local/production refund workflows passed, alongside typecheck/build and eight anonymous/CSRF checks. Migration 050 adds only new refund/request tables and preserves prior financial, loyalty, stock, outlet and KOT records. Q89 paid replacement remains pending; Q111/Q114 remain unanswered. Petpooja counts are unchanged.
